name: Cleopas (the Emmaus traveler)
title: The Emmaus traveler who met the risen one
summary: Cleopas was one of two disciples who met the risen Jesus on the road to Emmaus on Easter Sunday. He is known for his conversation with Jesus, whom he did not recognize until Jesus broke bread. His testimony confirms the reality of the resurrection and shows how Jesus opened the Scriptures to his followers.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Emmaus
keyEvents.description: Cleopas and another disciple walked to the village of Emmaus, about 11 kilometers from Jerusalem, and talked together about everything that had happened to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Meeting the Unknown Traveler
keyEvents.description: Jesus himself came and joined them, but they were prevented from recognizing him. Cleopas told him about the crucifixion and the reports of the empty tomb.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Opens the Scriptures
keyEvents.description: Jesus rebuked them for their unbelief and explained to them everything written about him in the Scriptures, from Moses and all the prophets.

keyEvents.title: Recognition at the Breaking of Bread
keyEvents.description: When Jesus broke the bread at the meal in Emmaus, their eyes were opened and they recognized him. At that same moment he became invisible to them.

keyEvents.title: The Testimony of the Apostles
keyEvents.description: Cleopas and his companion hurried back to Jerusalem to tell the eleven and the others that the Lord had truly risen.
